name: beyoutiful-organics
description: BeYoutiful Organics — premium organic skincare & haircare e-commerce platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
